snippet.title: Sword Sage: Awakening Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846900/Sword_Sage_Awakening/

Sword Sage: Awakening is an action RPG steeped in Chinese myth that features an adorable Red Panda companion. A new trailer provided a closer look at its fast-paced combat. It's coming soon to PC & consoles.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
